about: Every user-facing surface of the suite, where it lives, what states it has, which rules govern it, and how it was verified. scripts/styleguide-check.mjs rebuilds the list of screens from the products' own navigation declarations (discovery) and fails when a screen exists that is not recorded here.

flows.title: First run of the hub
flows.preconditions: A fresh data volume; the container is up on 127.0.0.1:4546.
steps: Open the admin page: the window, every tool locked, the sign-in form in the pane
Sign in with admin / admin
Overview opens with the amber gate; the other five tools stay locked
Choose a real password
Every tool unlocks
failures: Fewer than twelve characters, or two entries that differ: refused in a sentence
Login rate-limited after repeated failures
A deep link to a locked tab is ignored

flows.title: Pair a player or the companion
flows.preconditions: Setup complete; the device can reach the hub.
steps: Admin ticks the permissions and starts pairing (Devices): a code on the LCD plate
Device enters the hub’s address and the code
Both screens show the same verification code
Admin types it and confirms
Device receives a scoped credential; a companion granted library:share starts sharing (DEC-023)
failures: Code expired
Fingerprint differs: do not confirm
Wrong codes lock out that address for a while

flows.title: Pair with a PC and play its music, relay-carried
flows.preconditions: The companion app runs its AWSP sidecar on a PC; the player is the served build (a service worker is the bridge).
steps: On the PC, Settings ▸ Remote shows a ticket and a six-digit code
In the player, Sources ▸ Connections ▸ Stream from a PC: paste the ticket, type the code, Pair
The card shows the PC's name, relay-carried, and its track count; the tracks join the library
Play one; the bar follows the element and the indicator beside the transport reads relay-carried
The relay drops mid-track; the player reconnects and carries on from the last byte it held
failures: A wrong or expired code is refused in words, and nothing is stored
A revoked player is told to pair again, and stops reconnecting
The single-file copy has no service worker, and says streaming needs the served player

failures: Browser without folder access falls back to file choice
A file that disappeared says it cannot be found

flows.title: Listen together

steps: Switch the mode to Shared

failures: No hub: the switch explains why
Stale command: refused with the current revision
Member without the DJ role: vote-skip instead of skip

Audio follows the group timeline; pause, skip and seek from any device apply
failures: Not in a voice channel: the reply says so
Missing Connect/Speak: the reply names them
Source that cannot stream in Discord: skipped with the reason
Worker not running: the admin panel says so

flows.title: Downloaders set themselves up
flows.preconditions: The companion (or the standalone helper) starts on a machine without yt-dlp, spotDL or FFmpeg.
steps: The helper starts; the window opens without waiting
Each missing tool is fetched from its project's GitHub release, one at a time, and checked against the published SHA-256
Settings ▸ Downloaders shows Setting up… with progress, then Ready — Set up automatically
When FFmpeg lands, tempos are measured for the library without a rescan
failures: No published SHA-256, or a mismatch: nothing is installed; Couldn't set up with the reason and Try Again
Offline: retried on the next start or after six hours; Try Again retries at once
No build for this platform (FFmpeg on macOS/Linux): the install advice is shown instead

flows.title: Add a Live TV playlist and watch the guide fill in

steps: Companion ▸ Live TV: paste an M3U link and choose Add
The row reads checking… while the main process reads the link
Kept: the row reads ✓ and how many channels it holds
Paste an XMLTV link the same way for now and next
Open the player’s Live TV: the guide lists the companion’s channels, with what is on and what follows
failures: Not a playlist, not a guide, too large or on this PC’s own network: refused in a sentence under the field; what was typed stays; nothing is kept
A kept link stops answering: it keeps what it last held, says so, and offers Check Again
No companion, or one with no playlists: the player’s guide is as it was

flows.title: Find music, open a type’s page, file a song, keep a playlist
flows.preconditions: The player on Music. A paired hub, the companion on this PC, or neither (this browser asks the keyless services itself).
steps: Type a few words in the header search and press Enter: a calm overview arrives as each service answers — five songs, three artists, albums and playlists, each with “See all N” — every row naming its platforms, the quiet line saying how each service did; the card hangs centred under the field
Narrow with Filter (sections, services) or the Track / Artist / Album / ISRC fields

See all songs: the Songs page, scrolling on by itself; ‹ › or Page Up/Down move a page at a time (fetched first when needed); the page’s own field searches songs alone; the control switches to Artists, Albums or Playlists
Playlists: the starred ones first, then Deezer’s public playlists; open one in the music list, as an album opens
A song’s “…” (or right-click, long-press): Add to Up Next, Add to Playlist ▸, Add to Library, Download…, Audition — the HUD confirms
Open an artist, then one of their albums; open a song for its genre, label, year and lyrics; Back walks it back
Paste a playlist link: one listing with its platform and a 2×2 mosaic
Open it: the music list names it and loads every song, page by page, saying how far it has got
Star it in the silver bar: it is in the library menu under Playlists, under “In your library” on the Playlists page, and opens again from there
failures: A service fails, times out or is resting: the line says so; the rest still answer
Nothing reachable: the search says what happened, in words
A link nobody can read (a private or Spotify-made playlist, an Apple Music playlist, a Tidal link without a SongLink key): the reason
A list that stops loading part way: the songs so far stay, and it says why

flows.title: Find music, open it, keep it or download it (hub and companion)
flows.preconditions: The hub (signed in) or the companion with its helper running; no account or key anywhere.
steps: Search ▸ type a song, an artist, an album, an ISRC or paste a link
Watch each service answer on the status line; page through Songs, Artists, Albums
Open a song: preview, genre, label, year, lyrics
Download it (hub: into the queue with the rights basis; companion: through the helper)
Or open an album or a pasted playlist and star it into the library
failures: A service resting or failing: said on the status line, the others still answer
A link that cannot be read: the reason in words
A song only in a store: Download says it cannot be fetched from anywhere
The companion’s helper not running: the reason, with where to fix it
